title: The Stone That Healed the Garden

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE VI: LAVASTONES AND THE SCHOOLS OF THOUGHT (LCF-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Lavastones, the glowing orange-pink stones of Isola's lore, found on beaches and falling from the sky, and what they cost; and the island's schools of thought, Nature, Science, Spiritualism and Magic, arguing with and borrowing from each other.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A lavastone dropped in a blighted garden seems to have cured it: spread the dust to other gardens, or leave things be.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A blight has been killing the taro, and in one garden, where (subject) accidentally dropped a crumbling lavastone, the taro is suddenly healthy again. (friend) wants to scrape up the glowing soil and spread it around every garden. (subject) worries it might do something else entirely. What should they do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: They spread the glowing soil thinly across every garden. Most of the taro recovers. In one garden, the plants grow so fast and tall they topple over. The village eats very well, and very strangely shaped taro.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) leaves the soil where it is. The blight is beaten the slow way, by pulling up sick plants and planting new ones. The lavastone garden thrives all season. (friend) keeps looking at it longingly.
